interpretation: training-corpus replay: all released corpus entries are used for training by upstream, and all 600 query IDs map to the reconstructed vibration training split; not held-out validation

reference_label_audit.method: apply the same fixed label parser to official reference responses; no examples are removed from reported scores
reference_label_audit.caveat: references can themselves omit a diagnosis; high text overlap does not establish correctness

metric_definitions.generation: greedy natural generation; max_new_tokens as configured; official repetition penalty retained
metric_definitions.parsed_prediction: task0 leading yes/no; other tasks earliest explicit canonical class mention, absent=-1(error)
metric_definitions.unigram_f1: multiset word overlap F1 after the same normalization
metric_definitions.rouge_l_f1: exact word-level LCS F1 after the same normalization, without stemming
metric_definitions.reference_token_nll: teacher-forced reference response including terminal EOS; prompts excluded; not generated-token accuracy
metric_definitions.limitations: lexical overlap is not a maintenance/risk factuality or safety assessment; no human or LLM judge; no paper BERTScore claim
